steps: Define binary variable x_i for each area i in {A,...,L}: x_i=1 if we open a store at area i
For each area j, add constraint: sum_{i in cover_set[j]} x_i >= 1 (each area must be covered)
Objective: minimize sum_i x_i (minimize number of stores)
Solve with MILP solver (PuLP with CBC backend, integer variables)
